title: Tech Note: Customizing the Home Page Automatically Created by 4th Dimension 2003

historical_commentary.text: This note explains how to customize the default welcome page that 4D's built-in web server auto-generates when no home page exists, a small but practical piece of the classic Design Mode-era 4D Web server. The specific default-page HTML and its customization mechanism are tied to 4D's older web server implementation, which has been substantially rearchitected in later versions; the underlying idea of tailoring a database's default web presence for vertical-market deployment is still generally applicable, but the mechanics described here are dated.
related_updates: 4D's built-in web server has been substantially rearchitected in later versions with more configuration options for default content and behavior
Modern 4D web deployments typically serve custom static or dynamically-generated home pages rather than relying on the auto-generated welcome page this note customizes
